name: Git 历史追踪助手
description: 只读追踪本地 Git 文件的提交历史与行级 blame 归属，可展示指定提交的元数据与有界 diff，不改动工作区。

display_description.en: Read-only Git file history and blame line attribution with commit evidence (SHA/author/date); never touches the worktree.
display_description.zh: 只读追踪本地 Git 文件的提交历史与行级 blame 归属，可展示指定提交证据，不改动工作区。

default_init_input.zh: 追踪 src/app.py 的提交历史和每一行的最后修改者。
default_init_input.en: Trace the commit history of src/app.py and the last author of each line.

quick_inputs.zh: 追踪 src/app.py 的提交历史和每一行的最后修改者。
quick_inputs.en: Trace the commit history of src/app.py and the last author of each line.

quick_inputs.zh: 看看这几行代码是谁在哪个提交改的：src/app.py 第 42-48 行。
quick_inputs.en: Find who changed these lines and in which commit: src/app.py lines 42-48.

quick_inputs.zh: 展示最近一次修改 config.yaml 的提交及其差异。
quick_inputs.en: Show the latest commit that touched config.yaml along with its diff.

display_description.en: Read-only Git tracing: file history, blame line ranges and commit evidence with SHA/author/date preserved.
display_description.zh: 只读追踪 Git：文件提交历史、blame 行区间与提交证据，保留 SHA、作者与日期。
